notes.title: Steam Deck and Blazend V1.0.3 UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We appreciate all of your positive support for Blazend! It's hard to believe the game launched over a year ago.

With the new update to [b]1.0.3[/b], more features and accessibility options have been added. The main focus of my work has been to create a new "very easy" difficulty mode for novice players.

[b]The full list of changes are as follows:[/b]

[list]
[*]VERY EASY mode added and difficulties re-balanced (Normal mode is UNTOUCHED)
[*]When a boss hits 0 HP, all bullets are turned into score items
[*]End text after the clearing the game adjusted depending on difficulty
[*]Cheat list has been added to cheats menu that shows you the list of cheats for convenient access (Must beat the game at least once)
[*]Cheats can now be toggled using the gamepad by button combinations
[*]Brief descriptions added to video/game options
[*]New font added for better readability
[*]And MANY other small fixes...
[/list]

Here are some images to show off the new font and cheats menu!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313629/6daf86fe437dcc6ddb6d20022e08ec4958c2b3e8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313629/c614798efb997d544bc8b96f98186222c37f1f2e.png[/img]

FINALLY, I wanted to mention that I had the opportunity to try Blazend on the Steam Deck and I am happy to say that it works without any issues (so far)! While we do not yet have a "Deck Verified" status from Steam, the game gracefully supports the Steam Deck's resolution, and all of the Deck's built-in gamepad inputs as far as I have tested.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313629/bf4817031f582403373de35dc941651c81400b03.jpg[/img]

That's all for now everyone! Thank you for tuning again for this update, and until next time folks!

notes.title: Blazend Version 1.0.1 UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I would like to start off by saying I truly appreciate everyone that has given Blazend a chance and even moreso to those that left positive reviews. 

If you guys enjoyed the game and want to show support, please consider leaving a positive review as [b]this helps the game show up more in the discovery queue on Steam![/b]

That being said, it's been a while since the last update (almost a year ;-;), but I bring good news!

Blazend has been updated to version 1.0.1 and this update comes with various fixes and new additions.

[h3]Online Leaderboards[/h3]
Due to limitations, there is only one global leaderboard and it is shared across all difficulty levels

[h3]Screen Rotation (TATE)[/h3]
TATE mode relies on additional filters to smooth the image as without filters it renders artifacts on the screen. I am looking into alternate options, but I wanted to include rotation features in this update for everyone asking for it.

Other additions include consistent score items drop from bigger enemy ships, making the "Coin Collector" achievement more fair to get.

Other Fixes:
[list]
[*] Difficulty balancing
[*] Simplified menu layout
[*] Small bug fixes/audio issues
[/list]
This update was a long time coming and it took me a while to implement certain things within the short time I had with my busy schedule.

Thank you again for the support!

notes.title: Small content update and fixes
notes.content:
Further quality-of-life improvements thanks to suggestions and feedback from various players! This update also comes with various small bug fixes.

[list]
[*] Difficulty Levels now save
[*] Added additional ending screens that give cheat codes depending on what difficulty is cleared
[*] Adjusted enemy health pools for large enemies and bosses 
[*] Added function in options that allows players to adjust starting lives, allowing up to 5 lives
[*] Added QOL improvement that shows player continues at all times on the HUD
[*] Added more detail to the tutorial, tutorial can also be toggled from main menu
[*] Prevented player from shooting or bombing during a dialogue scene
[*] All dialogue font has been changed to support unique resolution displays, preventing the text from being cut off at certain points
[/list]

TATE mode is still being worked on as I have experienced issues with pixel distortion while resizing the game to fit vertically,

Thank you all!

notes.title: Blazend Update Patch 1
notes.content:
Thank you everyone regarding the feedback for Blazend version 1.0.

Thanks to a lot of you, I was able to pinpoint various bugs and have them fixed within a reasonable amount of time. This patch also comes with many of those fixes!

[b]UPDATES AND FIXES:[/b]

(01/09/2022) Blazend version has been updated with various bug fixes including:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with certain achievements not unlocking
[*] Fixed an issue where changing into windowed mode and starting Level 1 would change the window size again
[*] Implemented measures to prevent players with turbo mode functionality from breaking the game
[*] Fixed video mode toggle between RETRO/CRT
[*] Fixed issue where running out of continues and restarting the game would start you with 0 lives
[*] Other various bug fixes and quality of life improvements
[/list]

Future updates in the coming weeks will (hopefully) include:

[list]
[*] TATE mode
[*] In game achievement list
[/list]

Once again, thank you everyone for the feedback! 

Please continue to post any feedback or bugs in the discussions forums. Thanks again.
